KeyStory: He appears in Jahaziel's genealogy: Jahaziel the son of Zechariah, the son of Benaiah, the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah, a Levite of the sons of Asaph.
LifeLesson: Zechariah is named in Scripture only as Jahaziel's father, yet his name stands in the line God used at Judah's crisis. A quiet place in the story is still a place in the story.
Name: Zechariah, Father of Jahaziel
Role: Levite of the Sons of Asaph
Summary: Zechariah was a Levite of the sons of Asaph, named in Scripture as the father of Jahaziel, in the line given when the Spirit came upon his son.
